elevation.$description: Named elevation steps over the existing per-theme shadows. The Soft-Lift Rule still holds — there is exactly one lift shadow per theme — so this ramp names INTENT rather than introducing new shadow values. Because it references the theme-scoped shadow.lift / shadow.hairline tokens, each theme resolves it correctly with no per-theme elevation file.

flat.$description: No lift — the default for in-flow content.

hairline.$description: 1px inner ring that preserves an edge without a drop shadow.

raised.$description: The single Soft Lift — cards, tiles, popovers, toast.
